summary.text: 怎 asks “how?” or “in what way?” Its analyzed construction pairs 心, marking the heart or mind category, with 乍 as a phonetic element.

formation.text: 怎 is analyzed as a phonosemantic compound: 心 contributes the heart or mind category, and 乍 supplies a sound cue. Readings reported for 乍 and for the expression 作勿生 do not independently confirm the historical sound match within this graph.

components.text: 心 contributes the heart or mind meaning category in the analysis of 怎. The selected seal-script-style image is a modern rendering, not a dated early form of this graph.

乍 is identified as the phonetic component. The cited readings permit comparison, but the reported Middle Chinese comparison comes from a proposed history of 作勿生, not an independent reconstruction of 怎.

sound_limitation.text: The Middle Chinese reading cited for 怎 belongs to a proposed account of 作勿生／作沒生; it is not an independently established reading of this graph. No matched historical reconstruction for 乍 and 怎 establishes their sound relation in this character.

sound.text: Both are current Mandarin readings. Their difference alone neither confirms nor rules out an earlier sound relation.

A lexical-history proposal gives MC tsak for 作 in the reported forms 作勿生／作沒生. Comparing that with 乍 MC dzraeH is indirect: tsak is not an independently attested MC reading of the graph 怎, and this pair does not by itself establish the component’s phonetic role.
sound.system: Middle Chinese (Baxter–Sagart for 乍; reported lexical proposal for 作勿生／作沒生)

history.text: The selected seal-script-style images illustrate 心 and 乍, the components named in the analysis of 怎. They are modern digital renderings, not dated artifacts bearing 怎, and do not show a sequence of changes in its written form.

Historical discussions report expressions including 作勿生、作沒生 and 作摩／作麼 alongside 怎生 and 怎么. These are proposed histories of spoken interrogative expressions; they do not show that the whole graph 怎 was borrowed from another character.

One study adopts a proposed sound-and-meaning account linking 作勿生／作沒生 with later interrogative expressions. A competing account connects 怎生 with 作麽生, possibly treating 怎 as a contraction of 作麽, while noting that the forms’ dates do not settle which came first. The full sequence among these forms and 爭 remains unresolved.

uncertainties.text: The 心-plus-乍 analysis is supported, but the graph’s earliest form, first appearance, intermediate forms, and any graphic corruption remain undetermined in the supplied evidence.
No independent Middle Chinese or Old Chinese reconstruction for 怎 is supplied to establish a matched historical comparison with 乍; the reported tsak belongs to a lexical proposal concerning 作勿生／作沒生.
The lexical relationship among 作勿／作沒, 作麽生, 怎生, 怎么, and 爭 remains unresolved; the supplied evidence does not establish a complete semantic or phonological path.
The listed Japanese readings do not establish a Japanese-origin history for 怎.

senses.period: Song period and later examples cited; graph’s first attestation unresolved
senses.text: 怎 is used interrogatively to ask how or in what way; cited examples include a Song poem and later literary works. These examples do not date the graph’s first appearance.
Modern dictionary data also glosses 怎 as “what?”; the timing and relationship of this use to “how” are not established.

limitations.text: The cited interrogative uses do not establish a chronology between “how” and “what,” or the character’s original meaning.

A proposed lexical path linking forms such as 作勿生／作沒生 and 怎生／怎么 is supported in one account, but its complete sequence and relation to the competing 作麽生 analysis are not established. These are histories of spoken expressions, not a demonstrated semantic sequence for the single character 怎.

overview.text: 怎 asks “how?” or “in what way?” Its analyzed construction pairs 心, for the heart or mind category, with 乍 as a sound element; the historical sound match is not independently confirmed.

components.text: 心 marks the heart or mind meaning category.
乍 is identified as the sound element; the reported Middle Chinese comparison uses 作 in a proposed expression history and does not independently confirm 乍’s historical match to 怎.

relationships.text: 心 contributes the heart or mind meaning category in this analysis of 怎.

乍 is identified as the phonetic component. The current Mandarin readings are zhà and zěn. A reported Middle Chinese comparison gives dzraeH for 乍 and tsak for 作 in a proposed account of 作勿生／作沒生; tsak is not an independently established reading of 怎, so the comparison does not independently prove the phonetic role.
